facts.fact: The number of streaming service subscriptions passed 1 billion worldwide for the first time in 2020, according to a figure the page attributes to an LA Times report on an MPA theme report.
facts.quote: passed **1 billion** worldwide for the first time in 2020

facts.fact: As of March 2023, 78% of American households subscribe to at least one streaming service, according to Forbes as cited by the page.
facts.quote: **78%** of all American households subscribe to at least one or more streaming services.

facts.fact: Netflix has 231 million subscribers, which the page says makes it the most subscribed video streaming service globally.
facts.quote: With **231 million** subscribers, Netflix ranks as the most subscribed video streaming service globally.

facts.fact: In 2023, 88% of U.S. households owned at least one internet-connected TV device, according to Statista as cited by the page.
facts.quote: a whopping **88%** of U.S. households owned at least **one** internet-connected TV device

facts.fact: The number of CTV users among Gen Z and Millennials amounted to more than 110 million, according to the page's 2023 Statista citation.
facts.quote: the number of CTV users amounted to more than **110 million** among Gen Z and Millennials

facts.fact: CTV advertising spending in the United States was expected to grow by 21.2% to reach 25.09 billion USD in 2023, according to a Statista statistic cited by the page.
facts.quote: CTV advertising spending in the United States was expected to grow by **21.2%** to reach **25.09 billion** USD.

facts.fact: US CTV ad spend is expected to grow to 40.9 billion USD by 2027, according to a Statista projection cited by the page.
facts.quote: to grow to **40.9 billion** USD by 2027.

facts.fact: FAST platforms do not charge users any subscription fee and rely solely on advertising for monetization, according to the page's definition of FAST.
facts.quote: These platforms do not charge users any subscription fee
